method.analysis: Python AST traversal of imports, relative imports, package initializers and literal importlib imports; no application module was imported.
method.roots: Django entrypoints/settings/URL roots; core/land/law/design apps/models/admin/migrations; active-app management commands; conservative law.__getattr__ export candidates.
limitations: Static function/try/type-checking imports are conservative candidates, not proof of execution or required startup dependencies.
Management commands are a separate operational surface, not automatically an HTTP startup requirement.
File hash measures working tree, not clean commit.
Runtime-path candidates below include callable/optional branches and are not a complete write audit.
src is not in resolved local closure; do not infer it is safe to exclude from all operational workflows.
Literal absolute and literal package-relative import_module calls are resolved. Computed module/package expressions remain explicitly flagged; source/data closure is incomplete.
method.special_search_root: tmp_mass_check/_massv2/tools bare module names resolved conservatively for generate_massv2 sys.path extension. Actual import precedence must be verified in isolation.
method.scope_note: Scopes overlap; ASGI scope lists direct static ASGI/legacy imports and does not repeat HTTP roots initialized by get_asgi_application. Package initialization included. Candidate scopes do not imply top-level execution.

important_findings.finding: ASGI unconditionally imports gemini.routing although HTTP urls and INSTALLED_APPS disable gemini/agents. Transitive legacy ARR-local gemini/agents/graph_db files appear in conservative closure. These are distinct from shared D:/Data/25_ACE/agents.
important_findings.decision: Determine actual launch entrypoint and WebSocket requirement before excluding legacy packages. Do not auto-enable disabled Django apps.

important_findings.finding: generate_massv2 prepends tmp_mass_check/_massv2/tools then imports presentation.write_sequence. Source code lives under a runtime-looking directory.
important_findings.decision: Preserve exact presentation and resolved tool imports as source candidates; separately map runtime outputs. Current delivered_mass_export dynamically imports design.maas.delivered_book_rebuild and delivered_book_records, not tools.presentation.

important_findings.finding: Active Program-to-Plan endpoint publishes via program_plan_artifacts under BASE_DIR/tmp_mass_check/program_floor_plans.
important_findings.decision: Configure write root and validate receipt/artifact paths before relocating.

important_findings.finding: Graph2Plan source/model resolve outside ARR/backend via parents[4]/clone/Graph2Plan/Interface. model.model import and model/model.pth are outside static local closure.
important_findings.decision: Inventory clone source, model hash/license and configured root; new directory depth changes this path.

important_findings.finding: Optional research bridges compute clone/MAAS and clone/d4descent roots from parent depth; MAAS also reads labels.json and recovered book_case_eval.json.
important_findings.decision: Retain explicit blocked/optional behavior or approve separately versioned source/assets with license review. Do not silently omit or vendor external clone dependencies.

important_findings.finding: SQLite and log mkdir/file handlers currently write inside source root; log directory agents/logs does not imply shared agents ownership.
important_findings.decision: Use configured data/log roots and consistent SQLite backup; preserve migration labels.

important_findings.finding: Parent investigator reports provision.py requires backend/tmp_mass_check/<name>/tools physical depth because tools use parents[3] as backend; provisions tools, selective inputs corpus and runs/sweeps/*.json.
important_findings.decision: Block mechanical copy: explicitly separate Editor-owned source from external shared-agent workspace/state and change path compatibility. Shared agents/state remain under their external owner.
important_findings.verification: Cross-reference shared dependency inventory; reported source lines not independently executed.

important_findings.finding: graph_db.services.neo4j_service is also reachable from conservative HTTP design closure, independently of ASGI legacy app re-entry. Disabled installed-app status does not justify deleting graph_db support modules.
important_findings.decision: Preserve needed helper source and validate optional Neo4j behavior; do not activate entire legacy app.

Pin isolated Python/Django/dependency constraints against arr-runtime-baseline.json; resolve torch declared/observed mismatch without mutating installed environment.
Inventory and hash all referenced land/law catalogs, elevation tiles, book corpus, model weights and research clone files; preserve arr-required-assets manifest and configure absolute asset roots.
Redirect DB/log/cache/generated outputs to runtime/editor roots; exercise Program-to-Plan, delivered mass and management export artifact receipts with temporary fixtures.

In an isolated copy with original ARR/AG roots unavailable, run Django checks, URL resolution, migration-state comparison and feature contract tests; no model/network calls without appropriate later authorization.
Audit shared-agent ARR_BACKEND/editable/sys.path consumers and point them to HTTP or versioned new Editor-owned package; shared agents remain external and must not depend on original ARR path.
Verify source hashes/copy manifest, package init files and data packaging; distinguish runtime-looking source (presentation tools) from artifacts before copy exclusion rules.
Launch Django in separate cwd/environment to avoid Editor backend namespace collision; verify unavailable/optional features retain accurate status and no shared-agent lifecycle changes.
